summary: Advance failed global searches by code point in u/v mode but by UTF-16 code unit otherwise.

target.notes: When scanning for a global match after failure, AdvanceStringIndex uses code-point advancement under u/v and code-unit advancement otherwise; externally reported indices remain UTF-16 code-unit indices.

semantics.u_or_v: advance by code point on scan

caveats: This affects whether matching can begin inside a surrogate pair.

tests.name: unicode mode treats surrogate pair as code point
tests.input: const s='😀'; const r=/./gu; const m=r.exec(s); console.log(m[0],r.lastIndex);
